{{short description|Dutch chemist and academic}}
'''Isabel W.C.E. Arends''' (born 1966)<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=http://www.stw.nl/nl/content/isabel-arends-nieuw-bestuurslid-stw |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171210232058/http://www.stw.nl/nl/content/isabel-arends-nieuw-bestuurslid-stw |title=Isabel Arends nieuw bestuurslid STW |language=Dutch |publisher={{Interlanguage link multi|Technologiestichting STW|nl}} |date=19 December 2013 |archive-date=10 December 2017}}</ref> is a Dutch chemist and Director-General of the [[National Institute for Public Health and the Environment]] (RIVM).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Isabel Arends directeur-generaal RIVM per 1 april 2026 {{!}} RIVM |url=https://www.rivm.nl/nieuws/isabel-arends-directeur-generaal-rivm-per-1-april-2026 |access-date=2026-05-04 |website=www.rivm.nl}}</ref> 

During her academic career, her research focused on environmentally-friendly, or 'green', chemistry; for example, using [[enzyme]]s as biocatalysts while avoiding the need for [[Toxicity|toxic]] solvents.<ref name=knaw/> Arends was elected a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] (KNAW) in 2017.<ref name=knaw>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/12021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190210044612/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/12021 |title=Isabel Arends |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date= |archive-date=10 February 2019}}</ref><ref name="elects2017">{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/news/news/royal-academy-selects-26-new-members?set_language=en |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170605194808/https://www.knaw.nl/en/news/news/royal-academy-selects-26-new-members?set_language=en |title=Royal Academy selects 26 new members |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date=10 May 2017 |archive-date=5 June 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nwo.nl/en/news-and-events/news/2017/cw/new-knaw-members-include-three-chemists.html|title=New KNAW members include three chemists|website=www.nwo.nl|access-date=2019-02-09}}</ref> 

== Academic career ==
Arends studied physical organic chemistry at [[Leiden University]], between 1984 and 1988, obtaining an MsC. In 1993, she obtained her PhD at the same university with a thesis titled: 'Thermolysis of arene derivatives with coal-type hydrogen donors', studying with Prof. Rob Louw and Dr. Peter Mulder.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.tudelft.nl/en/faculty-of-applied-sciences/about-faculty/departments/biotechnology/research-groups/biocatalysis/isabel-arends-group/|title=Isabel Arends Group|website=TU Delft|language=en|access-date=2019-02-09|archive-date=10 February 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190210152528/https://www.tudelft.nl/en/faculty-of-applied-sciences/about-faculty/departments/biotechnology/research-groups/biocatalysis/isabel-arends-group/|url-status=dead}}</ref> After graduation, Arends spent a year as a postdoctoral researcher in Ottawa, Canada at the [[Steacie Institute for Molecular Sciences]]. She joined [[Delft University of Technology]] in 1995, and was awarded a research fellowship of the Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences (KNAW) in the field of biomimetic oxidations.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://one-flow.org/beneficiaries/prof-dr-isabel-w-c-e-arends-tu-delft|title=One-Flow|website=one-flow.org|access-date=2019-02-09|archive-date=10 February 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190210044508/https://one-flow.org/beneficiaries/prof-dr-isabel-w-c-e-arends-tu-delft|url-status=dead}}</ref>  

Between 2001 and 2006, she worked as associate and assistant professor at Delft University of Technology. In 2007, she was promoted to full professor of Biocatalysis and Organic Chemistry.<ref name="tu">{{cite web|url=https://www.tudelft.nl/en/faculty-of-applied-sciences/about-faculty/departments/biotechnology/research-groups/biocatalysis/isabel-arends-group/|title=Isabel Arends Group|author=|date=|publisher=Delft University of Technology|accessdate=10 December 2017|archive-date=10 February 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190210152528/https://www.tudelft.nl/en/faculty-of-applied-sciences/about-faculty/departments/biotechnology/research-groups/biocatalysis/isabel-arends-group/|url-status=dead}}</ref> She served as the chair of the Biotechnology Department at [[Delft University of Technology]] from 2013 to 2018,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.tudelft.nl/en/faculty-of-applied-sciences/about-faculty/departments/biotechnology/research-groups/biocatalysis/isabel-arends-group/|title=Isabel Arends Group|website=TU Delft|language=en|access-date=2019-02-09|archive-date=10 February 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190210152528/https://www.tudelft.nl/en/faculty-of-applied-sciences/about-faculty/departments/biotechnology/research-groups/biocatalysis/isabel-arends-group/|url-status=dead}}</ref> vice-chair of the Applied and Engineering Sciences domain of the Netherlands Organisation for Scientific Research, and founded the TU Delft Bioengineering Institute in 2016.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uu.nl/en/news/isabel-arends-new-dean-of-the-faculty-of-science|title=Isabel Arends new dean of the Faculty of Science|date=2018-04-03|website=Utrecht University|language=en|access-date=2019-02-09}}</ref> 

In July 2018, Arends was appointed Professor of [[biocatalysis]] and [[organic chemistry]] at [[Utrecht University]] and [[Dean (education)|dean]] of its Faculty of Science.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uu.nl/en/news/isabel-arends-new-dean-of-the-faculty-of-science|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190210044745/https://www.uu.nl/en/news/isabel-arends-new-dean-of-the-faculty-of-science|title=Isabel Arends new dean of the Faculty of Science|date=2018-04-03|website=Utrecht University|language=en|archive-date=2019-02-10}}</ref> 

Since April 1st 2026, Arends is Director-General of the [[National Institute for Public Health and the Environment]] (RIVM).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Isabel Arends directeur-generaal RIVM per 1 april 2026 {{!}} RIVM |url=https://www.rivm.nl/nieuws/isabel-arends-directeur-generaal-rivm-per-1-april-2026 |access-date=2026-05-04 |website=www.rivm.nl}}</ref>
